title: Research unit ids with non-hex letters (fs05-01 style) are refused by script_run and six other scripts: widen the id pattern or rename the units
note: MEASURED 2026-11-01 (lane ML-RECIPE): script_run._ID_RE = RQ-\d{8}-(?:\d{3}|[0-9a-f]{4}-\d{2}); 'fs05' contains 's', not hex, so script_run --check refuses all four fs units ('is not RQ-YYYYMMDD-NNN'). The same pattern is enforced in dispatch_queue.py, research_result.py, research_queue.py, collect_runner_results.py, next_rq_id.py and kernel_main.py. Options: (a) widen the hex class to [0-9a-z] in all seven (loosens, adds no gate); (b) rename the four units to hex ids and fix references. Local runs by lane ML-RECIPE are unaffected meanwhile. Needs a decision on (a) vs (b).

observation.what: RQ-20261101-fs01-01/-fs02-01/-fs05-01/-fs06-01 pass script_run --check (or are renamed to hex ids) so the runner can dispatch them
